quote.author: Gina Mizell
quote.text:
Jabari Walker knows he is doing his job when he starts to hear “little slick comments” like this during a game: 

“Man, stop crashing.” 

“I can’t box you out.” 

The Sixers’ depleted frontcourt needs all the help it can get right now.

media.title: Jabari Walker keeping Sixers’ backup center group afloat and making ‘impactful plays’ for star-studded roster
media.description: Walker, a terrific rebounder despite his 6-foot-7 frame, is filling in as the Sixers' backup center while Adem Bona, Dominick Barlow, and Ariel Hukporti are all sidelined.

items.title: Ariel Hukporti, who signed with the Sixers during free agency and ruptured his Achilles tendon during the preseason, just rolled out in street clothes on a scooter to receive his ring. Big pop from the MSG faithful.

quote.author: Adam Aaronson
quote.text:
The Sixers have an injury report for tomorrow’s game @ New York:

Dean Wade – ankle – QUESTIONABLE

Anfernee Simons – hamstring – QUESTIONABLE

Adem Bona – foot – QUESTIONABLE

Dominick Barlow – back – OUT

Tacko Fall – quad – OUT

Ariel Hukporti – Achilles – OUT
